rows.answer_line: Breakout (a mini-Breakout / Arkanoid-style brick breaker on an 8×8 field).
Frogger / Freeway-style road crossing. The agent starts at the bottom and must cross lanes of wrapping, moving cars to reach the goal row at the top.
Pong (single-player, against a wall, like squash). The paddle sits in the left column and the ball bounces around the 8×8 court.
